title.original: RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation
title.zh: RLinf：通过宏观到微观流转换实现灵活高效的大规模强化学习
title.en: RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation

inclusion_reason.zh: RLinf 的 M2Flow 转换、弹性 worker 与画像调度可把多类 RL 工作流编译为高效执行流，属于通用训练运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: RLinf's M2Flow transformation, elastic workers, and profile-guided scheduling compile varied RL workflows into efficient execution flows, qualifying as a general training runtime.

abstract.zh: RLinf 以宏观到微观流转换自动拆解高层 RL 工作流的时间和空间结构，再重组为适合异构推理、奖励和训练资源的高吞吐执行流。
abstract.en: RLinf uses macro-to-micro flow transformation to decompose high-level RL workflows across time and space, then recomposes them into high-throughput execution flows over heterogeneous rollout, reward, and training resources.

problem.zh: RL 工作流具有动态轨迹、异构角色和频繁通信，固定拓扑的训练系统难以同时提供易组合性与高硬件利用率。
problem.en: RL workflows combine dynamic trajectories, heterogeneous roles, and frequent communication, so fixed-topology systems struggle to offer both composability and high hardware utilization.

approach.zh: M2Flow 自动切分工作流，借助自适应通信 worker、上下文切换和弹性流水线重排执行，再由画像驱动的调度器选择计划。
approach.en: M2Flow automatically partitions the workflow, uses adaptive-communication workers, context switching, and elastic pipelining to reshape execution, and selects plans with profile-guided scheduling.

system_design.zh: 用户描述宏观 RL 流，转换器生成细粒度任务图；worker 在不同角色间切换并弹性组管线，性能画像与调度层把任务映射到设备。
system_design.en: Users define a macro RL flow, a transformer emits a fine-grained task graph, workers switch roles and form elastic pipelines, and profiling plus scheduling maps those tasks to devices.

key_results.zh: 在推理 RL 与具身 RL 工作负载上，RLinf 的端到端训练吞吐持续优于所比较系统。
key_results.en: Across both reasoning-RL and embodied-RL workloads, RLinf consistently delivers higher end-to-end training throughput than the compared systems.

limitations.zh: 转换收益依赖任务可安全拆分和准确画像；动态重组增加运行时复杂度，跨角色状态切换也可能放大内存与调试成本。
limitations.en: Benefits depend on safely decomposable tasks and accurate profiles; dynamic recomposition increases runtime complexity, while role switching can add memory and debugging cost.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
